name: Petsfang Duct for CR10 MicroSwiss/Stock/E3D/Volcano/TevoTorn [hard]
description: A hard-difficulty cantilever bracket in PETG (FDM). Mounts flush to a vertical wall and cantilevers a 87.7 kg load 159 mm from the wall face. Minimize tip deflection under load — maximize absolute stiffness regardless of mass.
